transcript.text: We offer a free 30-minute consultation with one of our trained aesthetic practitioners to discuss your goals and recommend a treatment plan.

Yes, our consultations are completely free of charge. They're a great opportunity for you to discuss your goals and receive personalized recommendations from one of our trained aesthetic practitioners.
Great, I'd like to book one. I'm free Saturdays.
We're open on Saturdays from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM. You can book a consultation via our website at www.bloomaesthetics.com or through WhatsApp. Which method do you prefer?

summary.customer_intent: The customer inquired about consultations and proceeded to book a free consultation on a Saturday.
summary.recommended_next_action: Book free consultation via website or WhatsApp
summary.notes: Customer showed interest in a free consultation and was provided with booking options.
